newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech 4-wk T-bill auction average yield 12.28 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech 4-wk T-bill auction average yield 12.28 pct.

text.p: The average yield in an auction on Thursday of Czech Finance Ministry four-week treasury bills was 12.28 percent, and the four billion crowns on offer to the market was oversubscribed, the Czech National Bank said.
It said bids in the American-style auction totalled 10.63 billion crowns, with the maximum accepted bid at 12.35 percent and the minimum accepted bid at 12.15 percent.
